objectives.statement: Recognize common Norwegian verbs that are normally used with a reflexive pronoun.
Choose the reflexive pronoun that matches the subject of a reflexive verb.
Tell when a verb changes meaning with reflexive use, especially with sitting down and going to bed.
Build short Bokmål sentences with reflexive verbs in natural word order.

notes: Must teach verbs that require reflexive pronouns and verbs whose meaning changes with reflexive use.
